loop.choice: round-robin item by checkpoint index; trajectory direction (worse->intensify, first attenuates)
loop.eval: symmetric sandboxed fit/test on clones, adopt iff candErr<incErr*0.99 else keep, skip if store<16
loop.billing: flat fee 2*(fitN+testN)*(tasteDimensions+1) per selfmod evaluation; random pays only its rng draw
loop.random: same item, coin flip from live feedRngState, applied blindly, logged with flip

scope: RSI-SELF V1b single attempt. No tuning; conjunctive G1-G5 verdict + G6 label decide; no RSI claim.
